name: Other Agent Skills hosts (shared .agents folder)

surfaces.name: Any host that reads ~/.agents/skills (Amp, Factory, OpenHands, Mistral Vibe and others in the Agent Skills client list)

notes: One copy here is read by several hosts: Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Roo Code and Goose all list ~/.agents/skills. Hosts not listed individually were not checked: confirm the folder in your host's documentation.
prerequisites: A host that implements the Agent Skills standard
Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Agent Skills specification and client list
docs.facts: name: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, matching the folder; description 1-1024 characters; optional license, compatibility (up to 500 characters), metadata, allowed-tools (experimental). The client list names 46 products.

install.evidence: installer tests put the skill in ~/.agents/skills; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#other-agent-skills-hosts

discovery.evidence: Codex lists the copy in ~/.agents/skills in its model-visible prompt; other hosts that read this folder were not run; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#codex
